speaker: Sheldon
text: Your head goes on the other end. It's culturally universal. A bed, even a temporary bed, is always oriented with the headboard away from the door. It serves the ancient imperative of protecting oneself against marauders.

speaker: Penny
text: I'll risk it. Anything else I should know?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes, if you use my toothbrush, I'll jump out that window. Please don't come to my funeral. Have a good night.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sorry about that. FYI, his toothbrush is the red one in the plexiglass case under the UV light. Uh, sleep tight.

speaker: Leonard
text: Funny expression, sleep tight. It refers to the early construction of beds which featured a mattress suspended on interlocking ropes which would occasionally, sleep tight.
